metrics.definition: TikTok views reported for this account and source reporting day, under the recorded source filters; not unique viewers or music streams.
TikTok profile views in this source reporting day and scope; not unique people unless explicitly defined by the source.
Explicitly reported net follower change in this source reporting day; signed and separate from gross new followers and the follower balance.
Follower balance at the source daily endpoint, not new followers or an additive count.
